title: Legacy dungeon treasure item recovery — 2026-10-18
assumptions: See legacy-treasure-migration-20261018.md for identities, exact live contracts, formerly functional baseline, exclusions and evidence.

Low/base/high: 1/5/20 participants redeem 0.25/1/8 existing formerly unusable units of EACH category per active day. This is restored stock sensitivity; acquisition rates and outstanding stock are unknown.

Conversion changes neither stack quantity nor currency balance. Only subsequent normal redemption pays once. Functional coin-token payout delta is zero. Keyed legacy AE/SF without roll metadata previously drew once; current presets draw 1–2 / 4–5 respectively.

Four money flows use actual uniform treasury pools, not obsolete Gaussian custom_data or tooltip means. AE/SF draws and vault are separate units. No new premium tokens, EliteMobs crystals or XP are directly granted.

No new prices, progression costs, taxes, multipliers, permissions or source of items. SELL availability and planned SELL-to-contract transition unchanged. Downstream sale and redemption of the same item are alternatives.

Repeat conversion must be idempotent and preserve count. Foreign PDC, decorations, conflicting identities and already-modern roll metadata are excluded. Invalid/missing factory result preserves original.
